# Value Unbound Solutions

> Expert Salesforce cost optimization and CRM consulting for German SMEs and international businesses. Based in Berlin, Germany.

## About

Value Unbound Solutions is an independent advisory firm that helps mid-size companies escape the Salesforce complexity trap. We reduce CRM license costs by 30-50% through systematic audits, license rightsizing, and feature rationalization. Founded by Arun Kumar Saini, a Salesforce Certified Application Architect with 15+ years of enterprise experience.

## Services

- Salesforce Cost Optimization & License Audit
- Process Automation & AI Integration
- System Integration (vendor-neutral)
- Strategic CRM Advisory
- Custom CPQ Development (Salesforce-native)
